assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Triangle ABC with the blue angle bisector from A along a horizontal line through L on BC and the red median AD. Vertical grey perpendiculars from B and C meet the bisector at P and Q (right-angle marks) and the median line at M (between A and D) and N (beyond D). Dashed segments LM and LN are parallel to AB and AC.

difficulty_rationale: Choosing the angle bisector as an axis makes both perpendiculars vertical lines; the rest is a short vector computation.
